summary.text: John Chee is the Republican candidate for the Oregon State Senate, District 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Lisa Reynolds (D). A software engineer, he advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Chee graduated from Westview High School and earned a graduate degree from Portland State University.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in the Bethany neighborhood of Portland, earned bachelor's and master's degrees in computer science at Portland State, and worked as a software engineer in the San Francisco Bay Area, including at X (formerly Twitter).

Chee's listed campaign messages included lowering property taxes and eliminating taxes on family inheritances, and defending what he called traditional family values, including opposition to abortion.
